- **A3** (Peach Sale / Chris / 2019-10-01) → **0.17**

The formula uses `MATCH(1, (type)*(salesperson)*(date>=start)*(date<=end), 0)` to return a "1" when all criteria (including the date-range check) hold, then `INDEX` returns the corresponding rate. Both results were verified independently and submitted successfully.
